<description>
**Problem:** AssumeUTXO verifies imported UTXOs against a hash we bake into the binary.
Every node reconstructs the same UTXO set during ordinary IBD, but [does not check its hash against the existing AssumeUTXO commitment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/32377).

**Fix:** During ordinary block validation, verify the provided AssumeUTXO hash when block connection reaches the corresponding block, stopping the node on a mismatch.
Flush pending changes to disk before hashing the UTXO set and comparing the result with the commitment.

Keep only the latest AssumeUTXO commitment per network to limit the extra hashing work during IBD, and update the release process to replace it.
Users who need older snapshots for research or other purposes can use a compatible older release or restore the corresponding commitment as `m_assumeutxo_data` and recompile.
</description>

<commits>
1606010c94 test: move AssumeUTXO commitments into test fixtures

Move the height-110 and height-200 regtest commitments into their unit and fuzz fixtures.
Keep the immutable fixture parameters alive across chainstate-manager restarts.
Leave only the height-299 functional-test commitment in the default regtest parameters.
Persist block-index test edits before reloading to prepare for the IBD check's forced flush.
Check that an unrelated chain passes the fixture's commitment height without starting a UTXO scan.
Check that interrupted snapshot validation leaves the snapshot unvalidated and can be retried.

59eeb531b0 chainparams: use the latest AssumeUTXO commitment

Match AssumeUTXO imports, background validation, and chainstate reloads against the latest commitment.
Keep the height and block hash mismatch checks, and report the supported height for an unknown snapshot block hash.
Older AssumeUTXO commitments are no longer recognized.
All configured commitment lists are nonempty and ordered by increasing height, so the last entry supplies the same height as the previous max_element lookup for rollback exports.
Use the same accessor for the fixture checks and remove the optional lookup APIs and height list.

9646f56002 refactor: extract AssumeUTXO hash verification

Extract UTXO hashing, interruption handling, commitment comparison, and result logging from AssumeUTXO background validation.
Keep snapshot invalidation at the caller so ordinary block validation can reuse the check.
Use log wording that also fits ordinary block validation.

27705e415f refactor: store one AssumeUTXO commitment

All consumers now use only the latest commitment.
Retain only that commitment to limit the extra hashing work during IBD.
Remove the unused older production commitments and replace the vector with one optional `AssumeutxoData`.
Keep it disengaged until the network constructor assigns the commitment.

36a2a70452 validation: verify the provided AssumeUTXO hash

Verify the provided AssumeUTXO hash when block connection reaches the corresponding block.
Skip other chains at the same height.
This checks the developer-provided commitment against the UTXO set that every node reconstructs during IBD (see #32377).
Reuse the AssumeUTXO background verifier and its reporting.
Flush pending UTXO changes to disk before hashing the set.
Stop on a flush failure before updating the tip or mempool.
Request shutdown if UTXO statistics cannot be computed or the commitment does not match, preserving normal shutdown interruptions.
AssumeUTXO import verification and background validation remain mandatory.

c296123d4d validation: propagate snapshot verification errors

`MaybeValidateSnapshot()` already invalidates a failed snapshot and requests shutdown, but `ConnectTip()` reports success to its caller.
Return a runtime error for snapshot-validation failures without marking the connected block invalid.
Keep interrupted hashing distinct so normal shutdown does not become a validation failure.

97b2138e39 doc: describe latest AssumeUTXO commitment checks

Document hash verification at the corresponding block and shutdown on a mismatch.
Explain the compatibility change and how to use older snapshots for research.
Update the release instructions to replace the commitment instead of appending it.
</commits>
